svg.title: Consumer research pipeline
svg.desc: Eight stages, top to bottom. A person writes the brief and picks the sources and window. Python collects, normalises and scores. Claude filters, classifies sentiment, emotion and aspects, extracts themes and synthesises one insight per theme. The report and insights workbook come out at the bottom. Everything on the right leaves the run.
